content:
A new leak reveals that one of the most popular Apple Watch faces—Modular—will gain multiple new color customization options in watchOS 27. Here are the details.

The Modular face will get new color customization options in watchOS 27

Apple plans to expand Modular face customization options in watchOS 27.

Modular is a favorite face for many users because of its flexibility. It not only provides slots for many complications, but also lets you customize the face's appearance through different color options.

Aaron Perris discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 shows watchOS 27 will add nine new Modular color options.

This beta version doesn't have previews of those nine new colors yet. However, Perris found their names in the beta code.

Some of the new colors are likely to serve as previews for the new bands coming next month with the Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Separately, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple will launch a brand new Modular face in watchOS 27, inspired by the Modular Ultra.

Which face do you use most? Share it in the comments.
